question: From the viewpoint and facing direction of Image 1, which sequence correctly orders the four objects from left to right?

answer_choices.A: large painting, lamp, tv, black table
answer_choices.B: tv, black table, large painting, lamp
answer_choices.C: lamp, large painting, tv, black table
answer_choices.D: large painting, lamp, black table, tv

caption:
ORACLE SURFACE NORMAL MAP (same camera pose and field of view as Oracle RGB):
Colors encode surface orientation, not object color or distance. RGB channels encode normal components along camera-right (R), camera-up (G), and camera-forward (B): 0 = -1, about 128 = 0, and 255 = +1. Higher R/G/B means a stronger rightward/upward/forward component; a surface facing the camera has low B. Black means missing geometry. Combine this map with the numbered images and Oracle RGB.
